title: Tanahashi’s Final Road
summary: Hiroshi Tanahashi announces a final chapter after decades as New Japan’s Ace. His farewell journey ends with the rival most closely tied to the promotion’s modern rise.

chapters.title: The Ace announces the finish line
chapters.result: Tanahashi announces his retirement match for January 4, 2026.
chapters.context: House of Torture attacks after the announcement, immediately turning his farewell plans into another in-ring struggle.

chapters.title: One last match with the Rainmaker
chapters.result: Okada defeats Tanahashi in Tanahashi’s retirement match.
chapters.context: Their final singles meeting brings the Ace’s in-ring career to a close before the Tokyo Dome farewell ceremony.
